pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Acknowledge missing knowledge without unsupported system claims
lesson.when: Answering a query where required business knowledge or specific product information is missing from sources
lesson.do: State clearly that the specific information is not available in the provided sources
lesson.otherwise: Do not claim system state, missing system data, or inability to answer due to unverified system conditions
triggers: không có thông tin hệ thống
chưa thể trả lời chính xác
